Not a bundle resource: DABs alerts must be owned by the deploying identity (github-actions-deploy), which has no access to openalex.monitoring or the warehouse, and the bundle-level run_as (terraform_user) is rejected for alerts. Re-run the script to update.
query_text:
WITH night AS (
  SELECT current_date() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS d
),
f AS (
  SELECT snapshot_date,
         COUNT(*) AS n_checks,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'critical') AS n_critical,
         COUNT_IF(status = 'watch') AS n_watch,
         COUNT_IF(status IN ('no_data', 'insufficient_history', 'insufficient_n')) AS n_unscored,
         COALESCE(concat_ws(' · ', collect_list(CASE WHEN status = 'critical' THEN
           concat(check_id, COALESCE(concat('[', dimension, ']'), ''), ' ', ROUND(value, 3),
                  CASE WHEN page THEN ' (pages)' ELSE '' END) END)), '(none)') AS criticals,
         COALESCE(concat_ws(' · ', collect_list(CASE WHEN status = 'watch' THEN
           concat(check_id, COALESCE(concat('[', dimension, ']'), ''), ' ', ROUND(value, 3)) END)), '(none)') AS watches
  FROM openalex.monitoring.findings
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM night)
  GROUP BY snapshot_date
)
SELECT CAST(night.d AS STRING) AS report_date,
       COALESCE(r.headline, '(no report row for this night)') AS headline,
       COALESCE(f.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks,
       COALESCE(f.n_critical, 0) AS n_critical,
       COALESCE(f.n_watch, 0) AS n_watch,
       COALESCE(f.n_unscored, 0) AS n_unscored,
       COALESCE(f.criticals, '(no findings for this night)') AS criticals,
       COALESCE(f.watches, '(none)') AS watches,
       COALESCE(r.anomalies, '') AS anomalies,
       COALESCE(r.failures, '') AS failures,
       COALESCE(r.opportunities, '') AS opportunities,
       concat(CAST(night.d AS STRING), ' · ', COALESCE(f.n_critical, 0), ' critical, ',
              COALESCE(f.n_watch, 0), ' watch — ', COALESCE(r.headline, 'no report')) AS subject
FROM night
LEFT JOIN f ON f.snapshot_date = night.d
LEFT JOIN openalex.monitoring.reports r ON r.report_date = night.d
